title: Succession sowing for continuous harvest
summary: Spread harvest and failure risk by sowing small batches at intervals.
steps: Choose crops suited to repeated sowing, such as salad leaves, radish, beans or herbs in the appropriate season.
Sow a small labelled batch instead of the entire packet.
Record emergence and expected harvest; sow the next batch only if weather and water remain suitable.
Stop sowing when the crop will mature in unsuitable heat or cold.
Keep one batch as a reserve when pests or weather damage another.
